name: Meta Platforms

eyebrow.en: Meta Platforms, Inc. · Class A · Menlo Park, California
eyebrow.zh: Meta Platforms · A类股 · 加州门洛帕克

title.en: Ads are booming; the AI bill has arrived.
title.zh: 广告大卖，AI 账单也来了。

lede.en: Meta grew revenue 28% to $60.8B in Q2, but costs rose 55% and about $31B of capex ate almost all of its operating cash flow. 2026 capex is guided at $130–145B, Reality Labs still loses about $4.6B a quarter, and buybacks have slowed sharply.
lede.zh: Meta 第二季营收增 28% 至 608 亿美元，但成本增 55%，约 310 亿美元资本开支几乎吞掉全部经营现金流。2026 年资本开支指引 1300–1450 亿美元，Reality Labs 每季仍亏约 46 亿，回购大幅放缓。

s.zh: Q3 一致预期每股 $6.77 × 4 · GAAP 历史约 27 倍

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock fell about 10% after Q2 results on the capex and cost outlook.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。第二季财报后因资本开支与成本展望，股价下跌约 10%。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Q3 2025 GAAP EPS of $1.05 reflects a one-time tax charge. The last bar is the midpoint of Meta's Q3 2026 guidance of $61–64B.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。2025 第三季 GAAP 每股 $1.05 反映一次性税务费用。最后一根柱为 Meta 2026 第三季指引 610–640 亿美元的中值。

s.zh: +55% · 含 24 亿法律费用、12 亿遣散费

s.en: incl. finance leases · ~2× a year ago
s.zh: 含融资租赁 · 约为一年前两倍
汇率约 1 个百分点逆风

p.en: Revenue grew 28% in Q2 and between 16% and 33% in each of the last ten quarters, as AI-driven ad targeting and ranking keep working.
p.zh: 第二季营收增 28%，过去十个季度每季增长 16% 至 33%，AI 驱动的广告定向与排序持续见效。

p.en: The 2026 guide is $130–145B of capex and $165–169B of total expenses. Q2 free cash flow was just $0.8B on Meta's own measure.
p.zh: 2026 年资本开支指引 1300–1450 亿美元，总费用 1650–1690 亿。按 Meta 自身口径，第二季自由现金流仅 8 亿美元。

p.en: Meta issued about $55B of bonds over the last year. Total debt including leases (~$112B) now exceeds cash and securities (~$90B).
p.zh: 过去一年 Meta 发行约 550 亿美元债券。含租赁的总负债（约 1120 亿）已超过现金及证券（约 900 亿）。

p.en: The $61–64B Q3 guide implies growth of about 19–25%, down from 28%, and slightly below what analysts expected.
p.zh: 第三季 610–640 亿美元指引意味着增速约 19–25%，低于 28%，也略低于分析师预期。

p.en: Lost $4.62B in Q2 and more than $80B since 2020. Zuckerberg says 2026 is the peak loss year.
p.zh: 第二季亏损 46.2 亿美元，2020 年以来累计逾 800 亿。扎克伯格称 2026 年是亏损最高的一年。

p.en: Several US trials over harms to young users are scheduled this year, and Meta warns they could result in a material loss.
p.zh: 今年美国有多起涉及青少年用户伤害的审判，Meta 警告可能导致重大损失。

p.en: After US close. Guide: revenue $61–64B; consensus EPS ~$6.77.
p.zh: 美股收盘后。指引：营收 610–640 亿美元；一致预期每股约 $6.77。

h.zh: 第四季及 2026 全年业绩

p.en: Expected to include 2027 capex and expense outlooks.
p.zh: 预计将给出 2027 年资本开支与费用展望。

p.en: Several US trials are scheduled; outcomes could lead to material losses.
p.zh: 美国多起审判排期中，结果可能导致重大损失。

sources: Price, market cap, beta, targets and earnings date: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Meta Platforms, Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Meta Platforms, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第三季至 2026 年第二季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Meta generated $5–16B of free cash flow almost every quarter for five years, enough to fund large buybacks. Capex has more than tripled since early 2024, and in Q2 2026 it nearly matched operating cash flow: $31.9B in, $30.1B out, leaving $1.7B (Meta's own figure, which also deducts finance leases, was $0.8B).
read.zh: 过去五年 Meta 几乎每季产生 50–160 亿美元自由现金流，足以支撑大规模回购。自 2024 年初以来资本开支增至三倍以上，2026 年第二季几乎与经营现金流持平：流入 319 亿、流出 301 亿，剩余 17 亿（按 Meta 自身口径另扣融资租赁后为 8 亿）。

read.en: The $130–145B guide for 2026 implies about $87B of capex in the second half, so I expect free cash flow to turn negative, roughly −$9B a quarter, and to stay negative into 2027 if spending keeps rising. Meta is filling the gap with bonds, about $55B over the last year, and has slowed buybacks.
read.zh: 2026 年 1300–1450 亿美元的指引意味着下半年资本开支约 870 亿，因此我预计自由现金流将转负，每季约 −90 亿美元；若支出继续上升，2027 年仍将为负。Meta 以债券填补缺口（过去一年约 550 亿），并放缓了回购。

p.en: $50.9B of capex in the first half of 2026 (including finance leases) and about $87B more implied for the second half.
p.zh: 2026 年上半年资本开支 509 亿美元（含融资租赁），下半年隐含约 870 亿。

p.en: About $4.6B of operating losses a quarter on AR/VR and AI glasses.
p.zh: AR/VR 与 AI 眼镜每季营业亏损约 46 亿美元。

p.en: $2.4B of legal charges in Q2, with youth-safety trials still ahead.
p.zh: 第二季法律费用 24 亿美元，青少年安全审判尚未结束。

p.en: About $32B of operating cash flow a quarter from Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger ads.
p.zh: Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp 和 Messenger 广告每季带来约 320 亿美元经营现金流。
2026 年第二季 249 亿美元，2025 年第四季 299 亿。

bridgeNote.en: Before any new bonds or buybacks. Meta has been issuing debt roughly every other quarter.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入新发债券或回购。Meta 大约每两季发债一次。

extraNote.en: Capex here excludes principal payments on finance leases, which Meta includes in its own free cash flow measure.
extraNote.zh: 此处资本开支不含融资租赁本金支付，Meta 自身的自由现金流口径包含该项。
